lines.say: You paid for ten servers. Nine sit idle. One is drowning in requests.
lines.show: You paid for ten servers. Nine sit idle. One is drowning in requests.

lines.say: They all run copies of the same app. What is missing is a traffic director.
lines.show: They all run copies of the same app. What is missing is a traffic director.

lines.say: A load balancer decides which server gets each request, like each page load.
lines.show: A load balancer decides which server gets each request, like each page load.

lines.say: Round robin takes turns: one, two, three, then back to one.
lines.show: Round robin takes turns: one, two, three, then back to one.

lines.say: Another rule, least connections, picks the server with the fewest open connections. Different requests can take different amounts of time.
lines.show: Another rule, least connections, picks the server with the fewest open connections. Different requests can take different amounts of time.

lines.say: With health checks enabled, probes test each server. After enough failed checks, an unhealthy server gets skipped.
lines.show: With health checks enabled, probes test each server. After enough failed checks, an unhealthy server gets skipped.

lines.say: Add servers behind it when you need capacity. Your users keep the same address. Spare machines only help when traffic can reach them.
lines.show: Add servers behind it when you need capacity. Your users keep the same address. Spare machines only help when traffic can reach them.
